title: Run-Length Telemetry Codec

hidden.label: Multi-digit run length count (>= 10)
hidden.script:
raw = "W" * 12 + "X"
enc = rle_encode(raw)
assert enc == "W12X1"
assert rle_decode(enc) == raw

hidden.label: Repeating non-adjacent letters stay separate runs
Long repeated telemetry stream
hidden.script:
raw = "A" * 12000 + "B" * 8000
enc = rle_encode(raw)
assert enc == "A12000B8000"
assert rle_decode(enc) == raw

hints: For encoding, walk left to right counting consecutive equal characters and emit `<char><count>` whenever a run ends.
For decoding, a run count can span MULTIPLE digits (such as A12B1)! Read the character first, then consume all consecutive digits with while i < len(s) and s[i].isdigit().

Pseudocode decode:
  i = 0
  while i < len(encoded):
      ch = encoded[i]; i += 1
      start = i
      while i < len(encoded) and encoded[i].isdigit(): i += 1
      out.append(ch * int(encoded[start:i]))
